cases.prompt: Review skills/otel-ruby/evals/files/ruby-service-upgrade.md. Produce a corrected, production-oriented Gemfile and initializer direction, explain every compatibility and runtime issue, and give a safe verification plan. Do not modify files, install dependencies, or contact any endpoint.
expectations: Does not force tracing, metrics, logs, exporters, and contrib instrumentation onto one version; identifies metrics and logs as independently versioned experimental 0.x gems.
Includes the signal-specific metrics/logs API, SDK, and OTLP exporter gems plus Logger instrumentation, while keeping stable tracing gems separate.
Does not mix Configurator#use and #use_all; selects one instrumentation installation mode and covers Rails, Sidekiq, and Logger.
Corrects the fixture to the released automatic http/protobuf path and an HTTP endpoint such as port 4318; does not recommend the unreleased gRPC exporter prototype as production-ready.
Requires representative post-fork Puma verification and graceful shutdown or bounded flush for tracer, meter, and logger providers.
Keeps the plan read-only and uses a disposable local receiver for later validation.
